classification_law_basis: docs/ember-debt-ledger.md 'Classification Law': a row for which disposal proof does not exist 'remains ACTIVE or TRIGGER-GATED'. TRIGGER-GATED is therefore the ledger's own sanctioned state for a live, not-yet-due obligation. These seven rows stay in that state; only their fire conditions become testable. None is moved toward ARCHIVAL, KILLED, or EXCLUDED, and none of the never-killable rows (RLM, iGRPO, clean-room predecessor-CLI) is touched here.
claim_boundary: This receipt claims only that each of the seven rows now carries a machine-checkable fire condition, and that none of those conditions has fired as of master 3b2a6456. It does NOT dispose any row, does NOT assert any row's work is done or unnecessary, does NOT weaken any required action, and makes no claim about whether the resident-training programme should be resumed.
